test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Under which Section of the Factories Act, of 1948, is the employment of women and children near cotton openers prohibited?
solution:
Under the **Factories Act, 1948**, the employment of women and children near cotton openers is prohibited under **Section 27**.

According to this section:

__
 
• 
 
**Prohibition**: No woman or child can be employed in any part of a factory for pressing cotton where a cotton opener is currently in operation.

 
 
• 
 
**Safety Rationale**: This rule exists to protect these workers from risks such as fire (as pressing wet cotton bales can generate significant heat) and physical injury from steel straps that may snap open suddenly during the process.

 
 
• 
 
**Exception**: They may be allowed to work if the feed-end of the cotton opener is located in a room completely separated from the delivery end by a partition. This partition must extend to the roof or a height specified in writing by a factory inspector.

• 
 
**Section 21**: Fencing of machinery.

 
 
• 
 
**Section 25**: Self-acting machines.

 
 
• 
 
**Section 27**: **Prohibition of employment of women and children near cotton openers**.

 
 
• 
 
**Section 29**: Lifting machines, chains, ropes, and lifting tackles.
